Several kinds of side curve

The same curve drawn five ways. Black is the spine; the ochre lines are the side curves the kind produces. Nothing here is the law — it is a comparison bed. The character rail is the current plate law; the speed partner scales the speed pair (a PH position then scales by the square); the parallel is the mechanical offset; the scaled copy is the one the operator rejected; the mirror is the other way to get a partner.

Tschirnhausen and variations

The pieces a glue join can use. At every rational t the point and the slope are rational, so the piece can be cut there and the glue desk can join it; the slope is printed on the card. The node is at t = ±√3, so its slope is ±√3, not rational — a join there needs the quintic (state/SPEC-glue-int.md).
